description: Compact tree with delicate, lacy bipinnate leaves on a woody trunk. Sensitive to environmental changes.
commonExamples: Radermachera sinica (China doll plant, Serpent tree)
careTips: Keep soil evenly moist — drops leaves if too dry or after moving. Bright indirect light; avoid direct sun. Medium to high humidity. Fertilize monthly spring through summer. Prune to shape. Repot every 1-2 years. Non-toxic to pets.

description: Mediterranean tree with narrow silvery-green leaves. Popular as a compact indoor tree when given enough light.
careTips: Let top inch of soil dry between waterings. Needs very bright light — a south window is ideal. Low to medium humidity is fine. Fertilize monthly spring through fall. Prune to maintain size. Repot every 2-3 years. Non-toxic to pets.
